description: Alexandre Labelle at Polytechnique Montréal publishes supporting inputs for an end-of-life product-flow simulation of wine-bottle recovery in Le Val-Saint-François, Canada. The May 2021 deposit contains six spreadsheets covering municipality-level population, municipality and age distributions, car probabilities, age-related drinking and economic-activity probabilities, and roll-off collection locations. Separate PDFs document parameters and a review of recycling behaviour. These inputs can parameterise agent-based waste collection, participation and material-recovery scenarios. Files are freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is this regional application; the dates of the underlying surveys and exact spreadsheet fields are not stated in the landing-page metadata. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this package. A single local study still supplies reusable model inputs, but transfer elsewhere requires recalibration. Uncertainty, probability normalisation and executable model availability were not independently established. Only the file inventory and public description were inspected.
